results.title: Owner of Esparto fireworks company arrested at Disney World - Sacramento Bee
results.content: # Owner of Esparto fireworks company arrested at Disney World. Chee, the founder and CEO of a fireworks company that authorities say amounted to a sprawling, illegal pyrotechnics network spanning the length of California, was visiting Disney World’s Hollywood Studios near Lake Buena Vista, Florida, with his family Thursday when he was arrested in connection to last summer’s explosion in Esparto.. Chee was one of at least six people arrested Thursday who are tied to the July 1 explosion at a Yolo County property that stored illegal fireworks. The Orange County Corrections Department in Florida confirmed that Chee was arrested at Disney World. On Thursday, Chee and at least five other people were arrested in connection to the grand jury investigation. ##### Related Stories from Sacramento Bee. ### 7 arrests in Esparto fireworks blast: At least 4 charged with 7 counts of murder. ### These are the 7 people arrested Thursday in connection with the Esparto blast.

results.title: Lily Chee Signs With WME for Representation Across Fashion and Film - WWD
results.content: # Lily Chee Signs With WME for Representation Across Fashion and Film. Model and actress Lily Chee has signed with WME for representation, marking a new phase in her career spanning fashion and film. Her credits include appearances in Marvel’s “Daredevil,” “The Other Two,” the independent project “Nothing,” “Except Everything” and the feature film “Sunset Park.” The combination of fashion work and on-screen roles has positioned her as part of a group of young talent navigating both industries simultaneously. Chee has cultivated a Gen Z audience by sharing content that spans fashion shoots, travel and daily life across New York, Los Angeles, Europe and Hawaii. I’m excited to step into this next chapter of my career and build something meaningful together across fashion and film,” Chee said in a statement. At the same time, Chee will continue to be managed by Kyn Agency Group, with Range Media Partners overseeing her acting career. WWD and Women's Wear Daily are part of Penske Media Corporation.
